Taylor_CSM: Quick thought for MeridianPay renewal: run a targeted perf experiment — int8 quant + regional routing hedge (send a small % to warm regional pool). Goal: ~18% median latency drop and ~12% token cost savings. Renewal in 5w. Opinions?
Priya_CS: Good opportunity. Theyare about subtle quality drift. Need a short sampling policy and explicit abort criteria.
Diego_SE: Recommend 6% canary, automatic fallback to `meridian-v3-fp16`, blind eval on 350 customer prompts. Need baseline p50/p95 and sequence-length histogram.
Hana_RE: Baseline slice: median_seq=132, p75=260, p95 spikes at 16:00 UTC. Baseline latencies: p50=240ms, p95=720ms. Small slice: ```json
{"16": {"reqs":2100, "p50":305, "p95":730}}```
Diego_SE: Canary config draft:
```yaml
traffic_split: 0.06
model_variant: meridian-v3-int8
fallback: meridian-v3-fp16
monitoring: [latency, error_rate, semantic_similarity]
capture_samples: true
abort_if_quality_drop_pct: 1.0
```
Taylor_CSM: I'll ask the customer for permission to capture prompts and promise rollback within 45m if quality issues. They want the exact sample list.
infra_bot: Deploy: starting canary meridian-v3-int8 -> 6% traffic at 3415001138. Watch dashboard `canary/3415001111`.
infra_bot: Canary update: 30m in, p50 down 17%, p95 down 13%, error rate steady. No regression alerts.
Priya_CS: Great. Diego, please upload the sampled outputs and queue the blind eval. I'll draft a one-pager for renewal showing latency, cost delta, and sample notes.
Diego_SE: Uploaded samples to shared drive `/shared/meridian/3415001111_samples.json` and kicked off blind eval (350). Will abort if >1% quality delta. ETA 90m.
Taylor_CSM: Thanks all — if clean for 24h we put this in the renewal proposal as a recommended optimization. Action items: customer sign-off, sample list, rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
__notes: Short, realistic Slack coordination for a proactive int8 quant + routing canary tied to a renewal. Includes brief YAML and JSON snippets, deploy bot updates, and clear next steps.
